The execution failed because `hp:linesegarray` elements were still present in modified paragraphs. The `test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache` check in `test_outputs.py` failed with an `AssertionError` at line 71. 

This indicates that the logic to remove layout-cache elements from paragraphs containing the injected JSON values (Overview fields, Risk Tier with severity note, and Corrective Actions) was either not executed or failed to target all instances. 

Action: Ensure the script iterates through every `<hp:p>` element, checks if its text content (including all child `<hp:t>` nodes) contains any of the replacement fragments, and if so, removes the `<hp:linesegarray>` child element entirely.
reasoning: The trace provides a specific, actionable signal: the failure to remove the layout cache (hp:linesegarray) from modified paragraphs. Providing this as a trace/reflection is the most direct way to guide the Planner to fix the Python script logic.
